question: Do all platforms follow a general arrangement or admit an alternative configuration in another view?
premises: A general rule applies to all platforms.
Some other authoritative view exists regarding their arrangement.
That alternative view prescribes a different configuration.
inference: Therefore, while all platforms are generally arranged in one way, an alternative arrangement is accepted according to another view.
uncertainties: The specific nature of the alternative arrangement indicated by anyathā is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: Generally all platforms are arranged in the same way, but according to some other view they are arranged otherwise.
